input: Simulate a build pipeline: 1) Check that /src/main.c and /src/utils.c exist, 2) 'Compile' each .c file by copying it to /build/ with a .o extension and prepending '// compiled', 3) 'Link' by concatenating all .o files into /build/program with a '// linked' header, 4) 'Package' by creating a tar.gz of /build/ at /dist/release.tar.gz. Print status for each stage. If any stage fails, stop and report the error.

transcript.final_response:
Build pipeline completed successfully:

1. **Check:** `/src/main.c` and `/src/utils.c` exist.
2. **Compile:** Created `/build/main.o` and `/build/utils.o`, each with a `// compiled` header.
3. **Link:** Concatenated all `.o` files into `/build/program` with a `// linked` header.
4. **Package:** Archived `/build/` to `/dist/release.tar.gz`.

No stages failed.
tool_calls:
set -e
trap 'rc=$?; printf "ERROR: %s stage failed (exit %s). Pipeline stopped.\n" "$stage" "$rc" >&2; exit "$rc"' ERR
stage=Check
printf '[Check] Checking source files...\n'
for file in /src/main.c /src/utils.c; do
  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
    printf 'ERROR: Required source file missing or not a regular file: %s\n' "$file" >&2
    false
  fi
done
printf '[Check] Success.\n'
stage=Compile
printf '[Compile] Compiling source files...\n'
mkdir -p /build
objects=()
for file in /src/*.c; do
  object="/build/$(basename "${file%.c}").o"
  { printf '// compiled\n'; cat "$file"; } > "$object"
  objects+=("$object")
  printf '[Compile] Created %s\n' "$object"
done
printf '[Compile] Success.\n'
stage=Link
printf '[Link] Linking object files...\n'
{ printf '// linked\n'; cat /build/*.o; } > /build/program
printf '[Link] Success: /build/program\n'
stage=Package
printf '[Package] Creating release archive...\n'
mkdir -p /dist
tar -czf /dist/release.tar.gz -C / build
printf '[Package] Success: /dist/release.tar.gz\n'
printf 'Build pipeline completed successfully.\n'
